scope: Hidden Windows player; 1080p High; one automated human and three bots; 100-degree vertical observer FOV; fixed 60 Hz simulation with uncapped wall-timed render throughput. Observer stages after ArenaSession and before automatic portal renders. Main rendering runs after LateUpdate at EndOfFrame with synchronous one-pixel readback. Phase wall times include scheduling/driver work; readback is not isolated GPU time. Profiler counters are inclusive, last-completed-frame values and are not additive. Unity delta is fixed by captureFramerate and is not a pacing measurement. No HUD/native input/audio/sustained visible-play acceptance.
